title: FLP Intent
description: Declares a task class with trigger conditions, required capabilities, and a task-specific system prompt injection.

mode.description: 'keyword' matches on literal strings; 'intent' uses semantic classification; 'always' fires on every turn.

patterns.description: Keyword or intent patterns that activate this intent.

capabilities.description: Capability tags the runtime requires to execute this intent (e.g. 'code_analysis', 'web_search').

prompt.description: System prompt fragment injected when this intent is active.

attachments.description: File attachment types this intent can handle (e.g. 'image', 'pdf', 'code').

adapters.description: Preferred adapter IDs for this intent (e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai').

uses.description: References to other primitives this intent composes (e.g. '@acme/code-guideline').
